1.name: Data Cleaning, Imputation and Visualization
1.description: Clean student performance dataset by removing duplicates, imputing missing numerical values with mean, and visualizing distributions (histogram, scatter, and department bar chart).

exp-02.name: CM354 Machine Learning Lab - Experiment 2: Simple Linear Regression
exp-02.description: Simple Linear Regression covering random data (least squares), MBA salary dataset, and country dataset with regression diagnosis, outlier detection (Z-score, Cook's distance), and train-test evaluation.
